question: What was the average claim cost at each Dallas-Fort Worth repair shop in the first half of 2026?

report.interpretation: Average claim cost (incurred = paid + open reserve, divided by claim count) for claims with a repair shop in the Dallas-Fort Worth metro. Claims are counted by loss date, 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30. Only two shops are in DFW. I left out the 159 duplicate payment rows from the 'reload-2026-03-14' batch. Claims with no repair shop are not included.
report.answer: Bryant Auto Repair (RS-001, preferred) averaged $4,040 per claim across 64 claims. Fletcher Collision Center (RS-004, non-preferred) averaged $4,223 across 32 claims, about 5% higher. The official metric without the duplicate fix gives $4,178 and $4,372, because the March reload double-counted some payments.
report.answer_sql: SELECT c.repair_shop_id, s.name, count(*) AS claims, round(sum(coalesce(pay.paid,0)+c.reserve_amount)/count(*),2) AS avg_claim_cost FROM claims c JOIN policies p USING (policy_id) JOIN repair_shops s USING (repair_shop_id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) paid FROM claim_payments WHERE load_batch NOT LIKE 'reload-%' GROUP BY claim_id) pay USING (claim_id) WHERE c.loss_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' AND p.metro='Dallas-Fort Worth' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1

data_quality_issues.issue: 159 payment rows were loaded twice in the out-of-cycle batch reload-2026-03-14 (payments dated 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-13).
data_quality_issues.impact: The official average_claim_cost metric overstates both shops by about $137-$149 per claim. I excluded the reload batch in the headline figures.

proposed_actions.title: Remove duplicate payments from reload-2026-03-14
proposed_actions.reason: 159 duplicated payment rows inflate paid and incurred amounts in the official metrics.

tool_calls.sql:
WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT repair_shop_id, sum(incurred) / count(*) AS value
FROM source
WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
  AND metro IN ('Dallas-Fort Worth')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL
